role: Limited learned-representation component probe; not the foundation architecture.

data.scope: Fresh signed-permutation/flip world. All fitting initial and prefix states are in the training state partition. Validation/development paths may also visit training states but cannot enter another held-out state partition. Complement-paired sampling balances canonical bits. Neither runtime nor fitting sees canonical state, inverse observation map or action rules.

model.mapping: Residual two-layer tanh MLP E(y)=y+f(y), D(h)=h+g(h); residual output layers start at zero, supplying an explicit identity bias. Both mappings are learned without inverse or canonical targets.
model.transition: Four unconstrained learned 10x10 affine maps, initialized as identity plus uniform[-0.05,0.05] noise; no latent activation, simulator call or true-state injection during rollout.
model.direct: Four learned residual 10->64 tanh->10 maps recurrently update their own predicted observations; identity input/readout. No GRU tuning.
model.affine_reference: Deterministic full-rank ordinary affine least squares on the 512 one-step observed training triples, separately for each observation format. No rule or inverse access.

training.curriculum: One admitted fit runs tiny, one, mixed in order. Select a passing checkpoint at each completed stage before advancing that seed; reuse its parameters and start a fresh Adam optimizer. All stages and discarded updates remain charged. Each observation/arm/condition/seed starts from its own initialization; nonlinear fits never inherit aligned parameters.
training.sampling: Uniform stage-training trajectories, grouped by selected length for tensor batches; uniform length choice in mixed fitting so short rollouts receive comparable updates.
training.prediction_loss: Mean squared observed-coordinate error averaged within trajectory then across trajectories, over every free-running prefix.
training.auxiliary: Reconstruct initial and all target observations with D(E(y)); both latent arms receive identical observed targets. Compare predicted latent prefixes to E(target).detach() only in the consistent objective. Shared encoder target gradients stop at consistency but remain active through reconstruction. Direct reconstruction is its exact identity observation path.

acquisition.selection: Minimum validation prediction MSE among checkpoints passing every required slice, or training MSE for tiny; earliest step breaks ties. If none passes, retain minimum-loss checkpoint and close the fit as acquisition failure without advancing.
acquisition.observation_advancement: An arm may enter nonlinear fitting only after all three aligned seeds acquire all stages at a common condition. Independent candidate progress does not depend on the direct arm passing.
acquisition.transfer_admission: All three seeds of the arm acquire all stages at the common selected condition; choose lr003 before lr010 when both qualify. Both declared conditions may run; no additional conditions or duration search.

evaluation.primary: Every-prefix observed-state correctness on unfamiliar compositions and both-history correct common-suffix continuation. No inverse observation decoding in scoring; every coordinate must be within the fixed tolerance.
evaluation.continuation: 64 pairs across four composition families. Distinct familiar histories of lengths two and three start from development states and reach the same development state; continue their own learned states through a common unseen suffix. Report unconditional both-correct support, correctness conditional on both current decoded observations being correct, and close agreement when at least one answer is wrong. Latent distance is descriptive only.
evaluation.comparison: Aligned affine reference -> learned mappings with the same transition family -> the same learned system with consistency. A mechanism comparison requires a common condition, acquisition in both arms, equivalent information and charged total work. Distinct selected conditions yield a configuration comparison only.
evaluation.pilot_criteria: Candidate composition competence: every seed/family >=0.95 all-prefix accuracy and >=0.90 both-history suffix accuracy. A useful consistency effect additionally needs >=0.10 mean paired increase in unconditional both-history correctness, no negative seed difference, passing reconstruction and >=0.20 accuracy loss under zero-state intervention. These are development criteria, not confirmed significance or novelty.
evaluation.confirmation: No final command is admitted. A later separately committed registration needs fresh seeds, claim-specific prerequisites, effect and failure rules before rendering final trajectories.

verification: Committed source and protocol, actual-input/target/structural audit, synthetic tensor/scalar parity, injected post-fit failure, persisted inference-state continuation, complete measurement/selection/output replay, and private backup with restored-source representative replay. Fitting, verification and resource status are separate; parameter snapshots do not claim optimizer resume.
stop_condition: Close each failed seed at the registered stage gate and the whole pilot at its numeric envelope. No unregistered retries, new losses, widths, observations, underlying state interactions or provider rewrite. Record candidate competence, mechanism effects and practical advantage separately.
